whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.description: SAVA MOVIE is a leading streaming platform dedicated to bringing you the best entertainment experience from Laos and around the world.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Founded in 2020, SAVA MOVIE began with a simple mission: to revolutionize the way people access and enjoy digital entertainment. What started as a small startup has grown into a leading platform serving thousands of users worldwide.
story.paragraph2: Our journey has been marked by innovation, dedication, and an unwavering commitment to providing exceptional service. We believe in the power of technology to bring people together and create memorable experiences.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To provide high-quality, accessible entertainment that connects people through stories and culture.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be the most loved streaming platform in Southeast Asia, known for our diverse content and user experience.

passion.title: Passion
passion.description: We love what we do and it shows in every aspect of our service.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: We strive for excellence in everything we create and deliver.

collaboration.title: Collaboration

innovation.title: Innovation

q1.question: How do I subscribe?
q1.answer: Click on the Register button and fill in your details to create an account.

q2.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q2.answer: We accept various payment methods including credit cards, bank transfers, and mobile payments.

q3.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
q3.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings.
